purpose: Manual-only visible-change evidence for later candidate-review comparison. It is not an electrical diagnosis, a training label, or production ground truth.

annotation_protocol.input: Raw right.png versus raw wrong*.png pairs only, shown side by side without registration.
annotation_protocol.unit: one independently visible connected local change group; a bundle may remain one group when individual electrical connections cannot be determined from the image.
annotation_protocol.rule_for_global_ai_rerender: A clear local visible change may receive a review-evidence box, but it is excluded from local-coverage statistics when global rendering or viewpoint change prevents a fair comparison.
annotation_protocol.important_caveat: This is a manual visual annotation by the same reviewer who has previously seen model outputs. It improves traceability but is not a strict double-blind study.

coordinate_space.inspection_rendering: Each raw inspection image is resized to the reference canvas for side-by-side manual review; no registration is applied before drawing.
coordinate_space.warning: These are manual review-canvas boxes, not raw-image pixels and not post-alignment candidate coordinates. A future evaluator must map them explicitly before numerical overlap scoring.

metric_policy.future_comparison_requirement: Do not use a candidate-assisted draft as the manual standard. For scoring, transform review-canvas boxes to the candidate coordinate system and separately report the eligible four-image subset.

images.manual_observation: Broad text, component-detail, and framing variation; no one local connected change can be isolated reliably.
